##### Project general facts

Jumeirah Living Business Bay is a premium branded residential development offering a selection of two, three, and four-bedroom residences, as well as five-bedroom simplex and duplex penthouses. The development also features one exclusive full-floor master penthouse located on the top floor, providing an elevated level of privacy and exclusivity. Each residence is designed to a high standard of quality, reflecting the sophisticated character of branded living.

The development combines contemporary design with carefully selected finishes and materials, creating a refined residential environment. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to deliver an elevated living experience, while the tower’s design maximizes privileged views of the Dubai Canal and/or the Burj Khalifa. The combination of premium finishes and an iconic location contributes to the distinctive appeal of the residences.

The residences feature fully equipped kitchens with integrated appliances, providing a practical and modern living environment. The properties are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their interiors according to their individual preferences and lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s most recognizable and dynamic districts, combining modern residential towers, commercial developments, hotels, restaurants, and lifestyle destinations. Located directly south of Downtown Dubai, the area offers a contemporary urban environment with a vibrant atmosphere and convenient access to some of the city’s most prominent landmarks.

The district provides a wide range of amenities and services within easy reach, including restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, banks, medical facilities, and retail destinations. Business Bay also offers a variety of entertainment and leisure opportunities, with regular events, celebrations, and activities contributing to its lively character. Its proximity to the Dubai Canal further enhances the appeal of the area for residents seeking an active and modern lifestyle.

Business Bay benefits from its strategic central location and convenient connectivity to other key areas of Dubai. Its position near Downtown Dubai provides easy access to major business, retail, and entertainment destinations, while the surrounding infrastructure supports both everyday convenience and long-term lifestyle appeal. The combination of accessibility, amenities, and a sophisticated urban environment makes Business Bay a well-established destination for modern city living.
